target: at least one qualifying reported event within 25 statute miles during [start,end)
cohort: 15th monthly initializations, 2022–2024; frozen calendar pilot, not representative climatology

label_codes.0: no qualifying report in source; not proof of no event
label_codes.255: unresolved source metadata; exclude from fitting/scoring

tornado_geometry: great-circle segment between reported endpoints, clipped to window; not a surveyed path
report_count_definition: report_records are time-filtered CONUS records; regional_report_records intersect a sample neighborhood. County-segment records are not independent storms
